### 二、SPI LCD初始化流程（通用模式）

所有板卡的SPI LCD初始化遵循统一的NuttX框架，需要实现3个板级函数：

#### 1. `board_lcd_initialize()` - 硬件初始化
```
步骤: 配置GPIO(DC/RST/BCKL) -> 复位LCD -> 初始化SPI总线 -> 初始化LCD驱动
```

**ST7789方式**（直接使用NuttX框架驱动）：
```c
g_spidev = xxx_spibus_initialize(DISPLAY_SPI);
g_lcd = st7789_lcdinitialize(g_spidev);  // 框架自动完成LCD初始化
```

**ILI9341方式**（需要实现platform subdriver）：
```c
// 需要填充 ili9341_lcd_s 结构体的回调函数
priv->dev.select    = xxx_select;
priv->dev.deselect  = xxx_deselect;
priv->dev.sendcmd   = xxx_sendcmd;
priv->dev.sendparam = xxx_sendparam;
priv->dev.sendgram  = xxx_sendgram;
// ... 然后
g_lcd = ili9341_initialize(&priv->dev, 0);
```

#### 2. `board_lcd_getdev(int devno)` - 返回LCD设备对象
```c
struct lcd_dev_s *board_lcd_getdev(int devno) {
    return g_lcd;
}
```

#### 3. `board_lcd_uninitialize()` - 关闭LCD
```c
void board_lcd_uninitialize(void) {
    g_lcd->setpower(g_lcd, 0);
}
```

401	/****************************************************************************
402	 * Name: stm32_ili93414ws_sendblock
403	 *
404	 * Description:
405	 *   Send a number of words to the lcd driver.
406	 *
407	 * Input Parameters:
408	 *   spi    - Reference to the private device structure
409	 *   wd     - Reference to the words to send
410	 *   nwords - number of words to send
411	 *
412	 * Returned Value:
413	 *   On success - OK
414	 *
415	 ****************************************************************************/
416	
417	static int stm32_ili93414ws_sendblock(struct ili93414ws_lcd_s *lcd,
418	                                      const uint16_t *wd, uint16_t nwords)
419	{
420	  /* Set to bidirectional transmit mode and enable spi */
421	
422	  stm32_ili93414ws_spisendmode();
423	
424	  /* Check if 16-bit spi mode is configured for transmit */
425	
426	#ifdef CONFIG_STM32F429I_DISCO_ILI9341_SPIBITS16
427	  if ((getreg16(ILI93414WS_SPI_CR1) & SPI_CR1_DFF) != 0)
428	    {
429	      /* 16-bit spi mode */
430	
431	      const uint16_t *src  = wd;
432	            uint16_t word;
433	
434	      while (nwords-- > 0)
435	        {
436	          word = *src++;
437	          stm32_ili93414ws_sndword(word);
438	        }
439	    }
440	#else
441	  /* 8-bit spi mode is enabled for pixel data operations.
442	   * Each pixel must be transmitted by two write operations.
443	   */
444	
445	  if (lcd->gmode == 16)
446	    {
447	      /* 8-bit spi mode */
448	
449	      const uint16_t *src  = wd;
450	            uint16_t word;
451	
452	      while (nwords-- > 0)
453	        {
454	          word = *src++;
455	          stm32_ili93414ws_sndword((word >> 8));
456	          stm32_ili93414ws_sndword((word & 0xff));
457	        }
458	    }
459	#endif
460	  else
461	    {
462	      /* 8-bit spi mode */
463	
464	      const uint8_t *src = (const uint8_t *)wd;
465	      uint8_t word;
466	
467	      while (nwords-- > 0)
468	        {
469	          word = *src++;
470	          stm32_ili93414ws_sndword((uint16_t)word);
471	        }
472	    }
473	
474	  /* Wait until transmit is not busy after the last word is transmitted,
475	   * marked by the BSY flag in the cr1 register. This is necessary if
476	   * entering in halt mode or disable the spi periphery.
477	   */
478	
479	  while ((getreg16(ILI93414WS_SPI_SR) & SPI_SR_BSY) != 0);
480	
481	  /* Disable spi */
482	
483	  stm32_ili93414ws_spidisable();
484	
485	  return OK;
486	}

488	/****************************************************************************
489	 * Name: stm32_ili93414ws_recvword
490	 *
491	 * Description:
492	 *   Receive a word from the lcd driver.
493	 *
494	 * Input Parameters:
495	 *   None
496	 *
497	 * Returned Value:
498	 *   On success - The received word from the LCD Single Chip Driver.
499	 *   On error   - 0 (If timeout during receiving)
500	 *
501	 ****************************************************************************/
502	
503	static uint16_t stm32_ili93414ws_recvword(void)
504	{
505	  volatile int       n;
506	  volatile uint16_t  regval;
507	         irqstate_t  flags;
508	
509	  /* Disable interrupts during time critical spi sequence.
510	   * In bidrectional receive mode the data transfer can only be stopped by
511	   * disabling the spi device. This is here done by disabling the spi device
512	   * immediately after enabling it. If the pixel data stream is interrupted
513	   * during receiving, a synchronized transfer can not ensure. Especially on
514	   * higher frequency it can happen that the interrupted driver isn't fast
515	   * enough to stop transmitting by disabling the spi device. So pixels lost
516	   * but not recognized by the driver. This results in a big lock because
517	   * the driver wants to receive missing pixel data.
518	   * The critical section here ensures that the spi device is disabled fast
519	   * enough during a pixel is transmitted.
520	   */
521	
522	  flags = enter_critical_section();
523	
524	  /* Backup the content of the current cr1 register only 1 times */
525	
526	  regval = getreg16(ILI93414WS_SPI_CR1);
527	
528	  /* Enable spi device followed by disable the spi device.
529	   *
530	   * Ensure that the spi is disabled within 8 or 16 spi clock cycles
531	   * depending on the configured spi bit mode. This is necessary to prevent
532	   * that the next data word is transmitted by the slave before the RX
533	   * buffer is cleared.
534	   * Otherwise the RX buffer will be overwritten.
535	   *
536	   * Physically the spi clock is disabled after the current 8/16 clock cycles
537	   * are completed.
538	   */
539	
540	  regval |= SPI_CR1_SPE;
541	  putreg16(regval, ILI93414WS_SPI_CR1);
542	
543	  /* Disable spi device */
544	
545	  regval &= ~SPI_CR1_SPE;
546	  putreg16(regval, ILI93414WS_SPI_CR1);
547	
548	  /* The spi device is in disabled state so it is safe to enable interrupts */
549	
550	  leave_critical_section(flags);
551	
552	  /* Waits until the RX buffer is filled with the received data word
553	   * signalized by the spi hardware through the RXNE flag.
554	   * A busy loop is preferred against interrupt driven receiving method here
555	   * because this happened fairly often. Also we have to ensure to avoid a
556	   * big lock if the lcd driver doesn't send data anymore.
557	   * A latency of CPU clock / SPI clock * 16 SPI clocks should be enough
558	   * here.
559	   */
560	
561	  for (n = 0; n < ILI93414WS_RECV_CLK * 16; n++)
562	    {
563	      if ((getreg16(ILI93414WS_SPI_SR) & SPI_SR_RXNE) != 0)
564	        {
565	          /* Receive the data word from the RX buffer */
566	
567	          return getreg16(ILI93414WS_SPI_DR);
568	        }
569	    }
570	
571	  lcdinfo("Timeout during receiving pixel word\n");
572	
573	  return 0;
574	}

576	/****************************************************************************
577	 * Name: stm32_ili93414ws_recvblock
578	 *
579	 * Description:
580	 *   Receive a number of words from to the lcd driver.
581	 *   Note: The first received word is the dummy word and discarded!
582	 *
583	 * Input Parameters:
584	 *   spi    - Reference to the private device structure
585	 *   wd    -  Reference to where the words receive
586	 *   nwords - number of words to receive
587	 *
588	 * Returned Value:
589	 *  OK - On Success
590	 *
591	 ****************************************************************************/
592	
593	static int stm32_ili93414ws_recvblock(struct ili93414ws_lcd_s *lcd,
594	                                uint16_t *wd, uint16_t nwords)
595	{
596	  /* ili9341 uses a 18-bit pixel format packed in a 24-bit stream per pixel.
597	   * The following format is transmitted: RRRRRR00 GGGGGG00 BBBBBB00
598	   * Convert it to:                       RRRRRGGG GGGBBBBB
599	   */
600	
601	  /* Set to bidirectional transmit mode and disable spi */
602	
603	  stm32_ili93414ws_spirecvmode();
604	
605	  /* Check if 16-bit spi mode is configured for receive */
606	
607	#ifdef CONFIG_STM32F429I_DISCO_ILI9341_SPIBITS16
608	  /* Two contiguous pixel must be received by three read operations. */
609	
610	  if ((getreg16(ILI93414WS_SPI_CR1) & SPI_CR1_DFF) != 0)
611	    {
612	      /* 16-bit mode */
613	
614	      uint16_t *dest  = wd;
615	      uint16_t w1;
616	      uint16_t w2;
617	
618	      /* Receive first pixel */
619	
620	      if (nwords)
621	        {
622	          /* Discard the first 8 bit dummy */
623	
624	          /* 00000000 RRRRRR00 */
625	
626	          w1 = stm32_ili93414ws_recvword();
627	
628	          /* GGGGGG00 BBBBBB00 */
629	
630	          w2 = stm32_ili93414ws_recvword();
631	
632	          *dest++ = (((w1 << 8) & 0xf800) |
633	                     ((w2 >> 2) & 0x7e0) |
634	                     ((w2 >> 3) & 0x1f));
635	
636	          --nwords;
637	        }
638	
639	      /* Receive
640	       * if nwords even and greater than 2: pixel 2 to n-1
641	       * if nwords odd and greater than 2:  pixel 2 to n
642	       */
643	
644	      while (nwords--)
645	        {
646	          /* RRRRRR00 GGGGGG00 */
647	
648	          w1 = stm32_ili93414ws_recvword();
649	
650	          /* BBBBBB00 RRRRRR00 */
651	
652	          w2 = stm32_ili93414ws_recvword();
653	
654	          *dest++ = ((w1 & 0xf800) | ((w1 << 3) & 0x7e0) | (w2 >> 11));
655	
656	          if (!nwords)
657	            {
658	              break;
659	            }
660	
661	          /* GGGGGG00 BBBBBB00 */
662	
663	          w1 = stm32_ili93414ws_recvword();
664	
665	          *dest++ = (((w1 >> 5) & 0x7e0) |
666	                     ((w1 >> 3) & 0x1f) |
667	                     ((w2 << 8) & 0xf800));
668	
669	          --nwords;
670	        }
671	    }
672	#else
673	  /* 8-bit spi mode is enabled for pixel data operations.
674	   * Each pixel must be received by three read operations.
675	   */
676	
677	  if (lcd->gmode == 16)
678	    {
679	      /* 8-bit spi mode but 16-bit mode is done by two 8-bit transmits */
680	
681	      uint16_t *dest = wd;
682	
683	      /* Dummy read to discard the first 8 bit. */
684	
685	      stm32_ili93414ws_recvword();
686	
687	      while (nwords--)
688	        {
689	          uint8_t r;
690	          uint8_t g;
691	          uint8_t b;
692	
693	          r = (uint8_t)(stm32_ili93414ws_recvword() >> 3);
694	          g = (uint8_t)(stm32_ili93414ws_recvword() >> 2);
695	          b = (uint8_t)(stm32_ili93414ws_recvword() >> 3);
696	          *dest++ = ((r << 11) | (g << 5) | b);
697	        }
698	    }
699	#endif
700	  else
701	    {
702	      /* 8-bit mode */
703	
704	      uint8_t *dest = (uint8_t *)wd;
705	
706	      while (nwords--)
707	        {
708	          *dest++ = (uint8_t)stm32_ili93414ws_recvword();
709	        }
710	    }
711	
712	  /* Disable spi device is done by recvword  */
713	
714	  return OK;
715	}

769	/****************************************************************************
770	 * Name: stm32_ili93414ws_spiconfig
771	 *
772	 * Description:
773	 *   Disable spi device and configure to bidirectional mode.
774	 *
775	 * Input Parameters:
776	 *   lcd  - Reference to the private driver structure
777	 *
778	 * Returned Value:
779	 *   None
780	 *
781	 ****************************************************************************/
782	
783	static void stm32_ili93414ws_spiconfig(struct ili9341_lcd_s *lcd)
784	{
785	  struct ili93414ws_lcd_s *priv = (struct ili93414ws_lcd_s *)lcd;
786	  irqstate_t   flags;
787	
788	  uint16_t   clrbitscr1 = SPI_CR1_CPHA | SPI_CR1_CPOL | SPI_CR1_BR_MASK |
789	                          SPI_CR1_CRCEN | SPI_CR1_LSBFIRST | SPI_CR1_RXONLY |
790	                          SPI_CR1_DFF;
791	
792	  uint16_t   setbitscr1 = SPI_CR1_BIDIOE | SPI_CR1_BIDIMODE | SPI_CR1_MSTR |
793	                          SPI_CR1_SSI | SPI_CR1_SSM | ILI93414WS_SPI_BR;
794	
795	  uint16_t   clrbitscr2 = SPI_CR2_TXEIE | SPI_CR2_RXNEIE | SPI_CR2_ERRIE |
796	                          SPI_CR2_FRF | SPI_CR2_SSOE;
797	
798	  uint16_t   setbitscr2 = 0;
799	
800	  flags = enter_critical_section();
801	
802	  /* Disable spi */
803	
804	  stm32_ili93414ws_spidisable();
805	
806	  /* Set to default 8-bit transfer mode */
807	
808	  stm32_ili93414ws_set8bitmode(priv);
809	
810	#ifdef ILI93414WS_SPI
811	  /* Backup cr1 and cr2 register to be sure they will be usable
812	   * by default spi interface. Disable spi device here is necessary at the
813	   * time restoring the register during deselection.
814	   */
815	
816	  priv->cr2 = getreg16(ILI93414WS_SPI_CR2);
817	  priv->cr1 = getreg16(ILI93414WS_SPI_CR1);
818	#endif
819	
820	  /* Set spi device to bidirectional half duplex
821	   * Configure to master with 8-bit data format and SPIDEV_MODE0
822	   */
823	
824	  stm32_ili93414ws_modifycr1(setbitscr1, clrbitscr1);
825	
826	  /* Disable dma, set to motorola spi. */
827	
828	  stm32_ili93414ws_modifycr2(setbitscr2, clrbitscr2);
829	
830	  leave_critical_section(flags);
831	}

888	/****************************************************************************
889	 * Name: stm32_ili93414ws_select
890	 *
891	 * Description:
892	 *   Select the SPI, locking and re-configuring if necessary
893	 *
894	 * Input Parameters:
895	 *   spi  - Reference to the public driver structure
896	 *
897	 * Returned Value:
898	 *
899	 ****************************************************************************/
900	
901	#ifdef ILI93414WS_SPI
902	static void stm32_ili93414ws_select(struct ili9341_lcd_s *lcd)
903	{
904	  struct ili93414ws_lcd_s *priv = (struct ili93414ws_lcd_s *)lcd;
905	
906	  /* Select ili9341 (locking the SPI bus in case there are multiple
907	   * devices competing for the SPI bus
908	   */
909	
910	  SPI_LOCK(priv->spi, true);
